# EditMii
3DS Mii Database Editor

# Warning: This script is generated by AI.

# What can it do?
- Delete miis from StreetPass Mii Plaza without deleting Mii Maker miis.

# How to use it?
1. Mod your 3DS if you didn't already
2. Install FBI if you didn't already
3. Backup your NAND!
4. Open FBI
5. Go to CTR NAND/data/random characters/extdata/00048000/f000000b/00000000
6. Press "A" on "00000005"
7. Select "Copy"
8. Go back to FBIs Main Menu
9. Go to SD
10. Press "A" on "<current directory>"
11. Select "Paste"
12. Go to CTR NAND/data/random characters/extdata/00048000/f000000b/00000000
13. Press "A" on "00000006"
14. Select "Copy"
15. Go back to FBIs Main Menu
16. Go to SD
17. Press "A" on "<current directory>"
18. Select "Paste"
19. Turn off your 3DS
20. Copy the files from your SD Card to your PC
21. Launch the script
22. Select the files from your computer
23. Now you can do the things that you want to do.

# What after i edited it?
1. Copy the edited files to your SD Card
2. Install GodMode9 if you didn't already
3. Launch GodMode9
4. Go to SDCARD
5. Find your edited files
6. Press "Y" on 00000005
7. Go to SYSNAND CTRNAND/data/random characters/extdata/00048000/f000000b/00000000
8. Delete 00000005 and 00000006
9. On any file press "Y"
10. 00000005 should appear
11. Press R+A on 00000005
12. Select Calculate CMAC
13. If it fails, press click fix CMAC
14. Do the same for 00000006
15. Now you can exit GM9.
